title: Canonical valid Read Holding Registers
purpose: Construct a canonical documented valid request with correct framing and a conservative payload.
expected_behavior: Valid request parsed and processed by server; MBAP header and PDU fields validated correctly with no framing or length issues.
constraints_preserved: Prefer Modbus/TCP ADUs with a 7-byte MBAP header.
Use protocol identifier 0x0000 and keep MBAP length consistent.
Diversify unit identifiers, read/write/diagnostic and file-record functions.
issue_safety_notes: No copy of any historical crash payload; request is fully canonical and valid per protocol specification.
